body:
After arriving back to my office from attending a conference planning meeting with the American Association of Orthopaedic Executives' (AAOE), at the Gaylord Opryland Resort in Nashville. As a member of the Industry Relations Board (IRB), I am excited to share some thoughts about what I experienced there.

The AAOE Conference Committee is working hard to make next year's 50 th anniversary of the AAOE an incredible event (May 4 th â€" 7 th , 2019). The 50 th anniversary of the AAOE, strives to be the most enjoyable, exciting and educational conference the association has ever experienced.

The vendor partners of the AAOE are committed to this goal as well. They love the lively interaction that AAOE members have with the exhibitors there. As a potential exhibitor, be sure not to miss this one either! We all want this to be the one to be remembered for a very long time.

If, as an Orthopaedic Executive, you have not had the chance to attend one of these conferences, I would say to you, this is the one to sign-up for. If you haven't attended in a while, this is the one to return to. This conference should be the one no one is to miss!

Healthcare Compliance Pros loves to meet with our AAOE member friends, clients and partners at the conference each year. And yes, we will be doing the HCP Treasure Box again in 2019!! In celebration of the 50 th anniversary we plan on even more prizes! 50 prizes to celebrate 50 years! So, make sure to look for your key and we will see you there.
